name: GIN-Wallpaper-Calend
description: Smart Desktop Wallpaper with Calendar for Windows 10/11 (Custom Pictures folder auto-detection e.g. D:\docs\Pictures, clickable status notification to open and highlight file in Explorer, 📥 Download button, official Wallhaven API 4K integration)
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev
features: Custom & Relocated Pictures Directory: auto-detects D:\docs\Pictures, Windows Registry User Shell Folders (My Pictures and Personal/Documents), and Shell SHGetFolderPathW APIs
Clickable Status Link: clicking '✓ Сохранено в Pictures: <file>' instantly opens Windows Explorer and highlights the newly saved image (/select,<path>)
Interactive UI Feedback: status turns into a bright link color with IDC_HAND mouse cursor upon saving
📥 Download button in settings: saves current 4K UHD wallpaper without calendar overlay into <category>_001.jpg sequence
Anti-Duplication History Cache: sliding window of the last 100 wallpaper IDs with random seed on every search
Official Wallhaven 4K API source with 14 curated categories (Trucks & Jeeps, Girls/Fashion portraits, 3D, Nature, etc.)
Full trilingual EN/CS/RU localization, minimal installer, silent uninstaller, and ~1.5-2 MB idle RAM consumption
